Name: Judas of Galilee
Summary: Judas of Galilee rose in the days of the taxing and drew away many people after him, but he perished and his followers were dispersed. Gamaliel cited him alongside Theudas to counsel restraint toward the apostles.
KeyStory: Judas of Galilee rose at the taxing, drew many after him, and perished, and his followers scattered.
LifeLesson: Tax revolts and messianic claims both scatter in the end. Judas of Galilee is the caution beside Theudas.
